annotation.bound_parties_text: Eligible entities (businesses) operating personal delivery devices are bound, and the department of licensing must create the self-certification form.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: An eligible entity may operate a personal delivery device so long as all of the following requirements are met:
annotation.robot_provision_quote: The device is equipped with automated driving technology, including software and hardware, enabling the operation of the device, with the support and supervision of a remote personal delivery device operator.
